admission.justification: Known selections steer with the click without multiplying host lookups by document. The reproduction showed a blank/blocked pane for the host request duration on every change.

alternatives.option: Learn tree chats in one bounded batch from receipts and one live-agent listing, then correct at single-document read.
alternatives.reason: Known selections steer with the click without multiplying host lookups by document.

alternatives.option: Learn each document chat only when it is clicked.
alternatives.reason: The reproduction showed a blank/blocked pane for the host request duration on every change.
alternatives.reconsider_when: When tree discovery cannot be bounded for the real tree, return to the architect before substituting another design.

consequences: Unknown never means no chat; polling belongs to visible pane/tab lifetime.
context: A per-selection host read left the pane waiting on every click, even the first.
